question_types: Practical/Hands-On (exploit vulnerable machines, submit proof.txt files)

testing_centers.notes: All OffSec exams are taken online via OffSec's own proctored VPN lab environment. No external testing centers. Must use OffSec-provided VPN connection.

id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID shown to proctor via webcam at exam start.
exam_rules: Fully open-book/open-internet exam — research is allowed and expected. Automated tools like Metasploit are restricted (limited use for OSCP). Must write a professional penetration test report submitted within 24 hours after exam. AI-assisted answer generation is prohibited. Proctor monitors via webcam throughout.
target_audience: Individuals with a solid foundation in penetration testing and programming
recommended_experience: Strong skills in penetration testing and programming, with a strong understanding of C programming, assembly language, operating system internals (Windows), and debugging tools (such as WinDbg and Immunity Debugger)

prerequisites.description: OSCP or solid understanding of Windows internals and x86 assembly

retake_policy.notes: Retake attempts can be purchased separately. No mandatory waiting period. Retake pricing varies by course bundle.

domains.name: Understanding the mechanics of stack buffer overflows and learn how to exploit them to gain control of vulnerable programs

objectives.title: Utilizing IDA Pro with a debugger during reverse engineering and more advanced exploit development
Applying dynamic analysis to understand program behavior
Developing the skills to write your own custom shellcode, enabling you to perform specific actions on compromised systems
Mastering advanced techniques for exploiting stack overflows while bypassing modern security mitigations such as Data Execution Prevention (DEP) and Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR)
Completing extensive reverse engineering to find a way to leverage a format string vulnerability and develop a read primitive

official_study_resources.title: OffSec Learning Library (PEN-200/WEB-300/EXP-301)
official_study_resources.notes: Course material, lab time, and one exam attempt typically bundled together
